family.primitive_saturation_proof: Each D4/I0* local correction is at most 1 and each A1/I2 correction at most 1/2.  Thus a nonzero torsion section would have h(P)>=4-(1+1+1/2+1/2)=1, impossible. The trivial lattice is saturated.

theorem: The explicit rank-12 elliptic K3 families with generic NS U+D8(-1)+A1(-1)^2 and U+D4(-1)^2+A1(-1)^2 carry algebraic divisor-local-system meridians whose integral Picard actions are exactly the archived H10/16 D8-spinor and H10/45 D4-outer involutions. Their fixed nef sections are the certified finite-volume noncompact 16- and 45-facet Coxeter polytopes.
